verdict.rationale: WorkOS ships an official remote management MCP server. It lets MCP-compatible AI agents read and change the same dashboard data a user can, including organizations, connections, users and branding, so the workspace can be run through natural-language instructions to an agent. Natural-language operation depends on bringing your own MCP-compatible agent, and the docs give no detail on which operations are supported. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, documentation of tool coverage and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
